suppress.notes: CVE-2026-66299 only affects the optional WebSocket chat example shipped with the full Tomcat distribution. Apache states that deployments without the examples web application are not affected. Spring Boot embeds tomcat-embed-core; the resolved 11.0.24 JAR contains no examples or websocket/chat entries. Remove this rule and upgrade to Tomcat 11.0.25 as soon as that currently unreleased version is published. The exact PURL, version, CVE, expiry, and failBuildOnUnusedSuppressionRule prevent this exception from hiding any other Tomcat or dependency finding. Reference: https://tomcat.apache.org/security-11.html#Fixed_in_Apache_Tomcat_11.0.25
